## Source
.design/m5/45-ml-classifier.md — REQ-2, AC-1 + decomposition PR 2.

## Surface
- New module: `polaris-backend/src/classifier/`
  - `mod.rs` — re-exports
  - `client.rs` — `pub trait ClassifierClient` + production tonic impl + in-memory fixture impl
- Trait shape:
  ```rust
  #[async_trait::async_trait]
  pub trait ClassifierClient: Send + Sync + 'static {
      async fn classify(&self, req: ClassifyRequest)
          -> Result<ClassifyResponse, ClassifierError>;
      async fn health(&self) -> Result<HealthResponse, ClassifierError>;
      async fn feedback(&self, req: FeedbackRequest)
          -> Result<(), ClassifierError>;
  }
  ```
- Production impl: `pub struct TonicClassifierClient { channel: tonic::transport::Channel, name: String }` with `pub async fn connect(endpoint: &str, name: String) -> Result<Self, ClassifierError>`.
- Fixture impl: `pub struct FixtureClassifierClient { responses: Arc<DashMap<String, ClassifyResponse>> }` keyed by `event_id`.

## Rust-quality notes
- **`Box<dyn ClassifierClient>` for the dispatch dictionary** (one classifier per config entry). Per rust-quality §6: prefer generics for hot paths, but the classifier dispatch is NOT hot — the trait-object cost is dominated by the gRPC round-trip. Trait-object is the right call here.
- **`ClassifierError` is `thiserror`** with variants `Timeout`, `Unauthorized`, `Transport(#[from] tonic::Status)`, `RateLimited`, `BadResponse(String)`. Per rust-quality §3: each variant has a `# Errors`-relevant doc-comment.
- **`#[async_trait::async_trait]` is required** until stable `async fn` in traits (1.75+). Workspace MSRV should support both — check workspace Cargo.toml `rust-version`.
- **Per rust-quality §10**: production `classify()` wraps the inner gRPC call in `tokio::time::timeout(per_call_timeout, …)` — the 500ms default is part of the trait contract, not classifier-internal.
- **Fixture impl** uses `DashMap` (already a workspace dep via Leptos) for lock-free reads. Fixture is `Clone` so tests can hand the same instance to multiple test-spawned tasks.
- Per rust-quality §7: each public function has at least one doctest. The trait's `classify` doc shows a fixture-impl example.

## External references
- tonic client guide: https://github.com/hyperium/tonic/blob/master/examples/src/helloworld/client.rs
- `async_trait`: https://docs.rs/async-trait/latest/async_trait/
- `DashMap`: https://docs.rs/dashmap/latest/dashmap/

## Acceptance (AC-1 partial — wiring)
- [ ] `cargo test -p polaris-backend --lib classifier::client::tests` passes.
- [ ] Fixture impl + production impl both satisfy a shared trait-object test.
- [ ] `cargo doc -p polaris-backend --no-deps -- -D warnings` clean over the new module.
